test_isomap_simple_grid: test the manifold.Isomap class to preserve distances on a simple grid dataset with configurable eigen_solvers and path_methods
test_isomap_reconstruction_error: test the manifold.Isomap reconstruction_error method by comparing input and output kernels
test_transform: test the manifold.Isomap transform method to re-embed noisy versions of an S-curve dataset
test_pipeline: test manifold.Isomap as a transformer in a scikit-learn Pipeline with KNeighborsClassifier
test_isomap_clone_bug: test that manifold.Isomap parameters update correctly via set_params and are preserved across clones
